superseding_law_notice: Superseded effective 2026-08-01 by Royal Decree M/169 (14/08/1447H) — the new law's text is not yet verifiable and is not ingested; this record reflects the text in force as of the build date.
verification_methodology_note: Copyright Law «نظام حماية حقوق المؤلف» — Royal Decree M/41 dated 2/7/1424H (30 August 2003), superseding the earlier 1989 copyright law (Royal Decree M/11, 19/5/1410H). 7 chapters, 28 articles. laws.boe.gov.sa was unreachable this research pass (direct connection reset; r.jina.ai timed out twice; Wayback Machine snapshot existed but web.archive.org fetch was blocked/403'd in this sandbox) — only a WebSearch snippet of the BOE page (title, decree number, date, chapter list) was obtainable, used only for structural cross-check. PRIMARY WORKING SOURCE: qadha.org.sa (الجمعية العلمية القضائية السعودية, a Saudi judicial-studies professional association) — full verbatim article-by-article text interleaved with the Implementing Regulation, footnoted with the exact 2018 amendment decision text and citations to administrative-court rulings; extracted cleanly via pdftotext -layout (no scrambling). CROSS-CHECKED against WIPO Lex (entry sa062) for chapter/article count/order/titles (confirmed matching) — the WIPO Lex PDF itself extracted with word-internal character scrambling via the only tool path available, so it served only as a STRUCTURAL cross-check, not a verbatim source. Spot-checked against an independent Saudi lawyer's blog (almirjah.wordpress.com), which quotes several articles in their PRE-2018 wording (itself useful corroboration that the 2018 amendment is correctly reflected in the qadha.org.sa text and did occur as documented, rather than a contradiction). All 11 locations the 2018-amendment footnote says were changed were independently checked against the qadha.org.sa article bodies and confirmed to show 'الهيئة'/'المجلس' as the footnote describes. 2018 AMENDMENT: Council of Ministers Resolution No. 536 dated 19/10/1439H (3 July 2018) replaced 'الوزارة: وزارة الثقافة والإعلام' / 'الوزير: وزير الثقافة والإعلام' in Article 1's definitions with 'الهيئة: الهيئة السعودية للملكية الفكرية' / 'المجلس: مجلس إدارة الهيئة' (SAIP and its Board), and replaced the words 'الوزارة'->'الهيئة' and 'الوزير'->'المجلس' at every other occurrence throughout the law: 5 locations for الوزارة->الهيئة (art 7 paras 1-2, art 8 para 4, art 21 para 8, art 24), 6 locations for الوزير->المجلس (art 16 paras 1&3, art 22 'ثالثاً', art 25 paras 1-2, art 26). *** CRITICAL: THIS LAW IS BEING REPEALED EFFECTIVE 2026-08-01 by Royal Decree M/169, dated 14/08/1447H (2 February 2026), approved by the Council of Ministers 27 January 2026 and published in the Umm Al-Qura Official Gazette on 13 February 2026 — confirmed via multiple independent Arabic news outlets and English law-firm client alerts (blog.qanoniah.com, sabq.org, ajel.sa, reedsmith.com, mondaq.com, gowlingwlg.com). The new law's full Arabic primary text could NOT be verified this research pass (too new to be indexed by BOE/WIPO Lex/SAIP yet); reported substantive changes (AI training/data-mining exception, restructured neighboring rights, new administrative enforcement mechanisms, optional registration) come from secondary English-language legal-analysis sources only and are NOT ingested here — fabricating the new law's text would violate this corpus's zero-fabrication policy. This track ingests the CURRENTLY in-force M/41 text (accurate as of the build date, 2026-07-17) with the repeal explicitly flagged; a follow-up ingestion pass for M/169 is recommended once its primary text becomes available (expected around or after its 2026-08-01 effective date).

known_unresolved_discrepancies.description: This law (M/41, 2003, as amended 2018) is confirmed REPEALED effective 2026-08-01 by Royal Decree M/169 (14/08/1447H / 2 February 2026). The new law's full Arabic text could not be verified this research pass and is explicitly NOT ingested here. This track represents the currently in-force text as of the build date (2026-07-17) and will need a follow-up ingestion pass for M/169 once its primary text is verifiable.

laws.boe.gov.sa was unreachable this research pass (connection reset direct; r.jina.ai reader-proxy timeout x2; Wayback Machine blocked/403 in this sandbox). This track rests on qadha.org.sa's compiled text (a Saudi judicial-studies professional association publication) rather than a direct BOE-portal or byte-exact primary-PDF source. A fresh BOE retry, or a clean (non-scrambled) re-extraction of the WIPO Lex PDF, is recommended before this track is treated as fully primary-source-anchored.

One Wikisource transcription gives the decree date as '3/7/1424هـ' rather than '2/7/1424هـ'. Every other source checked (WIPO Lex Arabic/English metadata, qadha.org.sa, almirjah.wordpress.com, BOE search-index snippet) consistently gives 2/7/1424H, which this track uses; the Wikisource variant is treated as a likely transcription error but was not independently confirmed against a raw scan.
